title: Zcity
tagline: The virus reached the city. Climb it, swing it, and stack 10,000 GM for the vaccine.
blurb: The virus left the beach, and now it has the whole city. The OG still has it, and the only vaccine in midtown is behind a clinic door on Sixth Avenue, at 10,000 GM. So he takes the high road: up the walls, along them, and across the avenues on a line, over the traffic and the crowd. Knock out whoever comes for you and their GM spills where they fall: the infected, who climb after you, looters, quarantine troopers, and a brute with a name at every third level of heat. Weapons are hidden about the streets. Stack 10,000 GM before the virus takes you, and Dr. Reyes will be waiting.
mogPrompt: Take the outbreak to the city at night: the OG runs up the towers and swings between them, and the infected climb after him.
